QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] The Master's Teacher
QuestInfo.0: You've reached the peak of Wu Tien Mountain. Seeing the beautiful waterfall is its own reward, but you feel some incredible energy in the area as well. At the center of the waterfall is the great Mu Gong. Go talk to him.
